z-m-08-04.title: Rikodin tsallen sama: wa ya yi tsalle mafi tsayi?
z-m-08-04.topic: Kwatanta lamba mai gurbin goma ɗaya da lamba mai guraben goma uku
z-m-08-04.goal: Kwatanta ƙididdigar goma bisa darajar gurbi maimakon yawan lambobinta, sake duba hukunci idan sabon bayani ya zo, sannan ka ƙirƙiri misalin da ya karya ƙa’ida mara daidai.
z-m-08-04.material: A gasar wasanni ta makaranta, an auna rikodin tsallen sama na Seoyun da Dohyeon. Rikodi shi ne tsayin daga ƙasa zuwa sandar a mita (m), an auna da ma’aunin tef. Za a ba ka rikodin a mataki-mataki.
z-m-08-04.thinking.0: Sake duba hukuncinka yayin da ake ƙara bayanai
z-m-08-04.thinking.1: Kwatanta girman ƙididdigar goma bisa darajar gurbi
z-m-08-04.prereq.0: Karanta da rubuta ƙididdigar goma mai gurbi ɗaya, biyu, da uku
z-m-08-04.s.s1.prompt: Dubi bayanai ɗaya bayan ɗaya, tantance wanda ya yi tsalle sama, sannan ka sake duba hukuncinka idan sabon bayani ya zo.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.hint.0: A kowane mataki, yanke hukunci bisa abin da ka sani zuwa yanzu kawai, sannan ka fara rubuta da kalmomi ko hukuncinka ya canza da sabon bayani.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.hint.1: Sauya rikodin biyu zuwa ma’auni ɗaya sannan ka kwatanta su gefe da gefe.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Rikodin Seoyun 1.4 m ne, na Dohyeon kuma 1.38 m.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Idan ka kalli lambobin kawai, me kake tunani yanzu?
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Hukuncin cewa Seoyun ta fi tsalle da na cewa lokaci bai yi a yanke hukunci ba duk sun dace a wannan mataki. Za ka iya tantancewa ta fara kwatanta gurbin goma na farko.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wataƙila wannan hukunci ne da ya duba darajar gurbin goma da na ɗari.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Dohyeon ya fi tsalle sama, domin 38 ya fi 4.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ka karanta lambobin bayan waƙafi kamar lamba cikakkiya, ka kwatanta 38 da 4. Ga ƙididdigar goma, da farko dole ka duba wane gurbi ne kowace lamba take ciki.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Yana da wuya a tantance daga lambobin kawai.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Yarda da gaskiya cewa ba ka da tabbaci, ka jira sabon bayanin, ma hali ne mai ma’ana.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Manyan alamomin ma’aunin tef sun raba ɓangaren sama da 1 m zuwa sarari 10; idan aka sake raba kowane sarari zuwa 10, sarari 100 ne gaba ɗaya. 1.4 m na Seoyun sarari 4 ne sama da 1 m a manyan alamomi. 1.38 m na Dohyeon kuma sarari 38 ne a ma’aunin sarari 100. (1)
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Yanzu da ka ga bayanan ma’auni, wa kake tunanin ya fi tsayi?
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.1.after: 1.4 m daidai yake da 1.40 m, wato sarari 40 ne. Ko da lambobi sun yi kaɗan, darajar gurbi na iya sa lambar ta fi girma.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: A ma’aunin sarari 100, 1.4 sarari 40 ne, saboda haka ya fi sarari 38.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Sake duba ma’auni don tabbatar da cewa 38 ya yi ƙasa da 40.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Rikodin biyu suna a ma’aunin, saboda haka za a iya tantancewa da wannan bayanin.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Harin ma ta yi tsalle. Rikodinta 1.405 m ne. Tsayin Seoyun 1.4 m ɗaya ne ko an rubuta 1.40 m ko 1.400 m.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Wanne ya jera rikodin ukun daga mafi tsayi zuwa mafi ƙasa?
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.2.after: 1.405 ya fi 1.400 da 0.005. Saboda haka tsari shi ne Harin, Seoyun, Dohyeon. Tsarin Seoyun da Dohyeon bai canza da sabon bayani ba.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wannan shi ne tsarin da aka samu ta tunanin lambar da ke da lambobi da yawa ta fi girma. Rubuta 1.4 a matsayin 1.400 ka fara kwatantawa daga gurbin goma.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: 1.405 da 1.4 (=1.400) sun fara bambanta a gurbin dubu, 1.38 kuma ya bambanta a gurbin ɗari.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Seoyun da Harin iri ɗaya ne, Dohyeon kuma shi ne mafi ƙasa.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ka yi watsi da 5 da ke ƙarshen 1.405. 1.400 da 1.405 lambobi daban-daban ne.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.reflect: Ko da sabon bayani ya zo, hukuncin cewa Seoyun ta fi Dohyeon tsalle bai canza ba. Abin da ya canza shi ne matsayi bayan an ƙara Harin. Ana kwatanta ƙididdigar goma bisa darajar gurbin kowane lamba, ba bisa yawan lambobi ba.
z-m-08-04.s.s2.prompt: Wani aboki ya ce, ‘Lambar da ke da ƙarin lambobi bayan waƙafi ita ce mafi girma.’ Ka yi amfani da ƙididdigar goma biyu sababbi, ba 1.4, 1.38, ko 1.405 da ka gani ba, don nuna cewa furucin ba daidai ba ne sannan ka rubuta wacce ta fi girma.
z-m-08-04.s.s2.hint.0: Yi tunanin ƙididdigar goma biyu da lambobinsu na gurbin goma suka bambanta.
z-m-08-04.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta babbar lambar har zuwa wurin ɗarurruwan kashi (ka haɗa 0), sannan ka jera lambobin gefe da gefe ka kwatanta.
z-m-08-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: A cikin adadin decimal biyun da ka faɗa, shin wanda yake da ƙarin lambobi ne ƙarami?
z-m-08-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Shin ka yi la'akari da cewa ana iya rubuta tsawo iri ɗaya da adadin lambobi daban bayan alamar decimal (1.4 = 1.40)?
z-m-08-04.s.s2.model.0: Duba 0.5 da 0.45. 0.45 yana da ƙarin lambobi, amma 0.5 daidai yake da 0.50, saboda haka ya fi 0.45 girma.
z-m-08-04.s.s2.model.1: Akwai 2.3 da 2.27. 2.27 yana da ƙarin lambobi, amma 2.3 daidai yake da 2.30, saboda haka 2.3 ya fi girma.
z-m-08-04.s.s2.model.2: Duba 0.9 da 0.89. 0.89 yana da lambobi biyu bayan alamar decimal, amma 0.9=0.90, saboda haka 0.9 ya fi girma.

z-m-08-07.s.s2.ok.c2: a lamba ce mai lambobi uku.
z-m-08-07.s.s2.ok.c3: b lamba ce mai lambobi biyu.
z-m-08-07.title: Katin biyu sun samar da adadi mai lambobi nawa?
z-m-08-07.topic: Kimanta girman ninkawa da yawan lambobin amsa
z-m-08-07.goal: Gwada magana ta gama-gari da misalan karya, kimanta mafi ƙanƙanta da mafi girman yanayi, sannan ka faɗi iyakar sakamakon da zai yiwu tare da sharudda.
z-m-08-07.material: Mu ƙirƙiri ninkawa da katunan lambobi. Zana kati ɗaya mai lamba mai lambobi uku (100 zuwa 999) da wani kati mai lambobi biyu (10 zuwa 99), sannan ka ninka lambobin. Minseo ya ce, ‘Idan ka ninka lamba mai lambobi uku da mai lambobi biyu, a koyaushe sakamakon zai kasance mai lambobi biyar. Domin 3 + 2 = 5!’
z-m-08-07.thinking.0: Zaɓar misalan da za su iya zama misalan karya
z-m-08-07.thinking.1: Ƙirƙira da tabbatar da yanayi da dama da kanka
z-m-08-07.thinking.2: Kimanta iyakar sakamakon sannan ka yanke hukunci tare da sharudda
z-m-08-07.prereq.0: Ninkawa lamba mai lambobi uku da mai lambobi biyu ta kimantawa ko lissafi (matakin aji na 4)
z-m-08-07.prereq.1: Ƙirga lambobin da ke cikin lamba
z-m-08-07.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk ma'auratan katunan da za a iya amfani da su wajen nuna maganar Minseo ba daidai ba ce. Kafin lissafi, fara tunani ta kimantawa.
z-m-08-07.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane ma'aurata, canja lambobin biyu zuwa ɗari ko goma mafi kusa, sannan ka kimanta girman amsar ninkawa.
z-m-08-07.s.s1.hint.1: Rarraba zaɓuɓɓukan bisa ko amsar ninkawa ta kasa ko ta wuce 10000 (dubu goma).
z-m-08-07.s.s1.r.a: Kimanta kusan girman amsar ninkawa ta lambobi biyu mafi girma. Amsar tana da lambobi nawa?
z-m-08-07.s.s1.r.c: Gano ko 500 × 40 yana cikin dubbai ko dubban goma. Wannan ma'aurata za ta iya karya maganar Minseo?
z-m-08-07.s.s1.r.d: Wannan ninkawar katunan biyu mafi ƙanƙanta ce.
z-m-08-07.s.s1.r.e: Kimanta ko 120 × 50 yana cikin dubbai ko dubban goma.
z-m-08-07.s.s1.explain: Domin karya maganar Minseo, kana buƙatar ma'aurata da amsar ninkawarsu lamba ce mai lambobi huɗu. 345 × 27 = 9315, 100 × 10 = 1000, da 120 × 50 = 6000 duk lambobi ne masu lambobi huɗu. 999 × 99 = 98901 da 500 × 40 = 20000 lambobi ne masu lambobi biyar, don haka ba sa saɓa wa maganar Minseo.
z-m-08-07.s.s2.prompt: Gwada maganar Minseo. Zaɓi lamba mai lambobi uku a da lamba mai lambobi biyu b domin ƙirƙirar ma'aurata guda ɗaya mai amsar lambobi huɗu, da wani mai amsar lambobi biyar. (Ma'auratan biyun dole su samar da amsoshi masu adadin lambobi dabam.)
z-m-08-07.s.s2.hint.0: Fara da lambobi ƙanana, da farko ka ƙirga lambobin amsar ninkawa ga lambobi kamar 100 da 10.
z-m-08-07.s.s2.hint.1: Kimanta wanne daga a da b za ka ƙara girma, kuma nawa, domin amsar ninkawa ta wuce 10000.
z-m-08-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Lambobin da ke katunan lambobin halitta ne.
z-m-08-07.s.s2.fail.c2: a dole ta zama lamba mai lambobi uku daga 100 zuwa 999.
z-m-08-07.s.s2.fail.c3: b dole ta zama lamba mai lambobi biyu daga 10 zuwa 99.
z-m-08-07.s.s2.explain: Misali, 345 × 27 = 9315 lamba ce mai lambobi huɗu, 500 × 40 = 20000 kuma lamba ce mai lambobi biyar. 100 × 10 = 1000 da 120 × 50 = 6000 lambobi ne masu lambobi huɗu, 999 × 99 = 98901 da 250 × 60 = 15000 kuma masu lambobi biyar. Sai idan amsoshin ninkawar biyun suna da adadin lambobi dabam ne za a ƙirga.
z-m-08-07.s.s3.prompt: Me za ka iya faɗa game da yawan lambobin amsar ninkawa tsakanin lamba mai lambobi uku da mai lambobi biyu? Rubuta dalilinka ta kimanta ko lissafa ƙarami da mafi girman yanayi.
z-m-08-07.s.s3.hint.0: Ninka mafi ƙaramar lamba mai lambobi uku da mafi ƙaramar lamba mai lambobi biyu.
z-m-08-07.s.s3.hint.1: Kimanta ninkawar lambobi biyu mafi girma ta kwatanta da 100 × 100.
z-m-08-07.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: Mafi ƙaramin yanayi shi ne ...
z-m-08-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Shin ka gano adadin lambobin amsar mafi ƙaramin ninkawa (100 × 10) da mafi girma (999 × 99)?
z-m-08-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Shin ka yi tunanin yadda za ka san cewa duk amsoshin ninkawa da ke tsakanin suna da lambobi huɗu ko biyar?
z-m-08-07.s.s3.model.0: Lamba ce mai lambobi huɗu ko biyar. Mafi ƙarami, 100 × 10 = 1000, lamba ce mai lambobi huɗu; mafi girma, 999 × 99, ya kasa 100000 (dubu ɗari), don haka ba zai zama mai lambobi shida ba. A tsakani, tana zama mai lambobi biyar da zarar ta wuce 10000.
z-m-08-07.s.s3.model.1: Amsar ninkawa na iya zama mai lambobi 4 ko 5. 345 × 27 = 9315 yana da lambobi huɗu, 500 × 40 = 20000 kuma biyar. Ba zai kasa 1000 ba, kuma ba zai wuce dubu ɗari ba.
z-m-08-07.s.s3.model.2: Amsar ninkawa lamba ce mai lambobi huɗu ko biyar. Mafi ƙanƙanta, 100×10=1000, tana da lambobi huɗu; mafi girma, 999×99, ya kasa dubu ɗari, saboda haka yana da aƙalla lambobi biyar.

z-m-08-02.title: Katuna biyu da jimillarsu 90: maki ma za su yi daidai?
z-m-08-02.topic: Kwatanta samfurorin ninkar lambobi biyu masu lambobi biyu
z-m-08-02.goal: Fahimtar cewa misali guda ba zai tabbatar da ‘koyaushe iri ɗaya’ ba, ƙirƙirar misalai daban-daban da suka cika sharadi, kwatanta su, sannan a bayyana abin da ma’auratan da ke da maki mafi yawa suka yi tarayya.
z-m-08-02.material: Mu yi wasan katin lamba. Kowane kati yana da lambar halitta guda daga 10 zuwa 99. Ƙa’ida: zaɓi katuna biyu, lambobinsu su haɗu su zama 90 daidai. Maki su ne samfurin lambobin biyu. Sua ta zaɓi 40 da 50 ta samu maki 2000. Sai ta ce, ‘Idan jimilla 90 ce, maki koyaushe 2000 ne!’ Tsarin sanya katunan ba shi da muhimmanci. (30 da 60 da kuma 60 da 30 ma’aurata iri ɗaya ne.)
z-m-08-02.thinking.0: Bambance abin da misali guda ke nunawa da abin da ba ya nunawa
z-m-08-02.thinking.1: Samar da misalai da dama cikin sharadin
z-m-08-02.prereq.0: Ninkar lambobi masu lambobi biyu da juna (aji na 4, ba tare da kalkuleta ba)
z-m-08-02.prereq.1: Haɗa lambobin halitta ta yadda jimillarsu ta yi daidai
z-m-08-02.s.s1.prompt: Sua ta yi maganar ne bayan ganin sakamakon ma’aurata guda 40 da 50. Me sakamakon wannan ma’aurata ke gaya mana game da furucin Sua?
z-m-08-02.s.s1.hint.0: Furucin Sua ya ƙunshi kalmar ‘koyaushe’. Ka yi tunanin mataki mafi sauri don gano ko furucin gaskiya ne.
z-m-08-02.s.s1.hint.1: Ƙirƙiri wani ma’aurata guda ɗaya da jimillarsa 90 ka gano makin sa.
z-m-08-02.s.s1.o.a: 40 da 50 sun ba da maki 2000, don haka kowane ma’aurata yana ba da maki 2000.
z-m-08-02.s.s1.r.a: Daidaiton misali guda ba ya tabbatar da ‘koyaushe’. Yaya za a gwada wasu ma’aurata?
z-m-08-02.s.s1.o.b: Ba za a iya tantancewa ba sai mun duba wani ma’aurata mai jimillar 90.
z-m-08-02.s.s1.r.b: Ka nuna cewa misali guda kaɗai ba zai gaya mana ‘koyaushe’ ba.
z-m-08-02.s.s1.o.c: Za mu iya yanke hukunci yanzu cewa maki ba iri ɗaya ba ne ko da jimilloli iri ɗaya ne.
z-m-08-02.s.s1.r.c: Sakamakon ma’aurata guda kaɗai ba zai tabbatar da ‘ba iri ɗaya ba’ ba. Dole ka ƙirƙiri wasu ma’aurata da gaske ka kwatanta.
z-m-08-02.s.s1.o.d: Har yanzu ba mu sani ba. Don haka ba sai mun gwada wasu ma’aurata ba.
z-m-08-02.s.s1.r.d: Daidai ne ka ji ba ka sani ba, amma idan ba ka sani ba, mataki na gaba shi ne gwadawa.
z-m-08-02.s.s1.explain: Maki 2000 na ma’auratan 40 da 50 misali guda ne kawai da bai saɓa wa furucin Sua ba. Don sanin ko ‘idan jimilla 90 ce, maki koyaushe iri ɗaya ne’ gaskiya ne, dole a gwada wasu ma’aurata masu jimillar 90. Idan wani ma’aurata ya ba da maki daban, wannan misalin ya karya furucin.
z-m-08-02.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri ma’aurata 3 na katuna masu lambobi biyu, jimillarsu 90 kuma makinsu ya bambanta. (Sauya tsarin katunan biyu ba ya haifar da sabon ma’aurata.)
z-m-08-02.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko zaɓi katin farko, sannan ka cire lambarsa daga 90 don samun ta biyu.
z-m-08-02.s.s2.hint.1: Sauya katin farko, ka ci gaba daga 10 zuwa 90, amma ka tabbatar lambobin biyu duk lambobi ne masu lambobi biyu.
z-m-08-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Katunan suna ɗauke da lambobi na halitta kawai.
z-m-08-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Lambobin katunan lambobi ne masu lambobi biyu daga 10 zuwa 99.
z-m-08-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Jimillar lambobin biyu ba 90 ba ce. Haɗa su don dubawa.
z-m-08-02.s.s2.explain: Ma’auratan da jimillarsu 90 suna da maki daban-daban: misali (40, 50)=2000 maki, (30, 60)=1800 maki, (20, 70)=1400 maki, (45, 45)=2025 maki, da (11, 79)=869 maki. Wasu ma’aurata suna da jimilla iri ɗaya amma samfurori daban, saboda haka furucin Sua ba koyaushe yake daidai ba. Ma’aurata da aka juya (50 da 40) iri ɗaya ne, ƙirga shi sau ɗaya kawai.
z-m-08-02.s.s3.prompt: Kwatanta makin ma’auratan da ka ƙirƙira. Lambobin biyun a ma’auratan da suka fi maki sun kasance yaya? Bayyana hanya guda ta zaɓar katuna don ƙara maki, ta amfani da ma’auratan da ka samo a matsayin misalai.
z-m-08-02.s.s3.hint.0: Jera makin ma’auratan da ka ƙirƙira daga mafi yawa zuwa mafi kaɗan, sannan ka rubuta bambancin lambobin biyu a kowanne.
z-m-08-02.s.s3.hint.1: Kwatanta tazarar lambobi biyu a ma’auratan masu maki da yawa da waɗanda ke da kaɗan.
z-m-08-02.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: Ma’auratan da suka fi maki su ne ...
z-m-08-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Shin da gaske ka ninka don gano makin misalan da ka ƙirƙira?
z-m-08-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Za ka iya sake gwadawa ko sabon ma’auratan da ka zaɓa ta hanyar da ka bayyana zai ƙara maki da gaske?
z-m-08-02.s.s3.model.0: 40 da 50 sun ba da maki 2000, 30 da 60 sun ba da 1800, 20 da 70 kuma 1400. Da lambobin biyu suka fi kusa da juna, makin ya fi yawa. Don haka idan na zaɓi lambobi masu ƙaramin bambanci kamar 45 da 45, ina tsammanin zai fi yawa.
z-m-08-02.s.s3.model.1: Idan bambancin ma’auratan ya yi ƙasa, makin ya fi yawa. Bambancin 40 da 50 shi ne 10, makin kuma 2000; amma 20 da 70 suna da bambancin 50, makinsu 1400. Idan jimilla 90 ce, ya dace a zaɓi lambobi kusa da 45.

z-m-08-06.title: Idan ka haɗa ribbon biyu, za su kai 4 m?
z-m-08-06.topic: Haɗa lambobin decimal masu wurare biyu da ma'aunin tsawo
z-m-08-06.goal: Yanke shawarar ko za a iya kai wa ƙarshe daga bayanin da aka bayar, faɗi abin da kuma ake buƙatar sani, sannan ka nuna da lambobi yadda ƙarshe ke canzawa bisa sharudda.
z-m-08-06.material: Domin zagaye akwati gaba ɗaya sau ɗaya da ɗaure shi, kana buƙatar igiya aƙalla 4 m (daidai gwargwado). Kana da ribbon biyu: ja mai tsawon 2.4 m da shuɗi mai tsawon 1.65 m. Kana son haɗa ribbon ɗin biyu su zama guda. Har yanzu ba ka yanke shawarar ko za ka haɗa su ta ‘daidaita ƙarshen-karshe ka manna da tef’ ko ‘rufe ƙarshen juna ka manne’ ba.
z-m-08-06.thinking.1: Faɗin ƙarin bayanin da ake buƙata
z-m-08-06.thinking.2: Bayyana da lambobi ƙarshe da ke canzawa bisa sharudda
z-m-08-06.prereq.0: Haɗa adadin decimal masu wurare biyu
z-m-08-06.prereq.1: Sanin cewa 1 m = 100 cm da sauya ma'aunin tsawo
z-m-08-06.s.s1.prompt: Da bayanin da aka sani a yanzu kaɗai, za mu iya cewa ribbon ɗin zai iya ɗaure akwatin?
z-m-08-06.s.s1.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin hanyoyi biyu na haɗa ribbon ɗin da gaske, sannan ka rubuta jimillar tsawo ga kowace.
z-m-08-06.s.s1.hint.1: Ga kowane zaɓi, rubuta zato kan yadda aka haɗa ribbon ɗin da ake buƙata domin maganar ta yi daidai.
z-m-08-06.s.s1.o.a: Ba za mu iya sani ba. Muna buƙatar sanin wanne ribbon aka naɗa da farko
z-m-08-06.s.s1.r.a: Jerin naɗa ribbon ba ya shafar jimillar tsawo. Nemo bayanin da ke shafar tsawon.
z-m-08-06.s.s1.o.b: Ba za mu iya sani ba. Ya danganta da yadda aka haɗa, don haka muna buƙatar ƙarin bayani
z-m-08-06.s.s1.r.b: Ka nuna cewa ko akwai tsawon da ya rufe juna ya danganta da yadda aka haɗa su.
z-m-08-06.s.s1.o.c: Za mu iya ɗaure shi. 2.4 + 1.65 = 4.05, wanda ya fi 4
z-m-08-06.s.s1.r.c: Haɗa tsawon ribbon biyun ya yi daidai har yanzu. Amma shin wannan jimilla za ta kasance yadda take, ya danganta da yadda aka haɗa su?
z-m-08-06.s.s1.o.d: Ba za mu iya ɗaure shi ba. 1.65 ya gaza 2.4, saboda haka bai kai 4 ba
z-m-08-06.s.s1.r.d: Idan ka haɗa su, za ka yi amfani da cikakken tsawon ribbon biyun. Ka sake duba dalilin da ya sa ka yanke hukunci ta kallon wanda ya fi gajarta kawai.
z-m-08-06.s.s1.explain: Idan an daidaita ƙarshensu aka haɗa, tsawon ba ya raguwa kuma 4.05 m ya isa. Idan an rufe su juna, tsawon yana raguwa da adadin rufewar, saboda haka ko ya isa ya danganta da sanin tsawon rufewar. Ba a yanke hanyar haɗawa ba tukuna, don haka ‘muna buƙatar ƙarin bayani’ ita ce amsa daidai. Sai da zato cewa an haɗa ƙarshen da ƙarshen za ka iya cewa ‘za mu iya ɗaure shi.’
z-m-08-06.s.s2.prompt: Ka yanke shawarar rufe ribbon ɗin juna ka manne. Ana iya zaɓar tsawon rufewar a matsayin cikakken adadin cm daga 1 cm zuwa 8 cm. Rubuta tsawon rufewa x (cm) uku dabam-dabam da za su sa ribbon ɗin da aka haɗa ya kasance aƙalla 4 m.
z-m-08-06.s.s2.hint.0: Canja tsawon ribbon biyun daga m zuwa cm, ka rubuta su gefe da gefe.
z-m-08-06.s.s2.hint.1: Canja tsawon rufewar da 1 cm a kowane mataki, sannan ka duba ko tsawon haɗin ya kai 400 cm ko fiye.
z-m-08-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Tsawon rufewar cikakken adadin cm ne.
z-m-08-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Rubuta tsawon rufewar a matsayin cikakken adadin cm.
z-m-08-06.s.s2.ok.c2: Tsawon rufewar yana tsakanin 1 cm da 8 cm.
z-m-08-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Dole ne tsawon rufewar ya kai aƙalla 1 cm kuma ya kasance 8 cm ko ƙasa.
z-m-08-06.s.s2.ok.c3: Ribbon ɗin da aka haɗa yana da tsawon 4 m ko fiye.
z-m-08-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Tsawon haɗin bai kai 4 m (400 cm) ba. Canja tsawon ribbon biyun zuwa cm, haɗa su, sannan ka cire rufewar domin tabbatarwa.
z-m-08-06.s.s2.explain: Ribbon ja mai tsawon 2.4 m yana da 240 cm, shuɗi mai 1.65 m kuma 165 cm; jimillarsu 405 cm ce. Domin ya kasance 400 cm ko fiye bayan cire rufewar, tsawon rufewa dole ya zama 5 cm ko ƙasa. 1, 2, 3, 4, da 5 cm duk suna yiwuwa; daga 6 cm zuwa sama ya gaza 400 cm. Hali marar rufewa (0 cm) ma ya isa, amma a wannan matsalar ka yanke shawarar rufewa ka manne.
z-m-08-06.s.s3.prompt: Idan ka yanke shawarar rufe su ka manne, ta yaya ake tantance ko wannan ribbon zai iya ɗaure akwatin? Yi amfani da 4.05 m, ka danganta bayaninka da tsawon rufewar.
z-m-08-06.s.s3.hint.0: Canja bambancin 4.05 m da 4 m zuwa cm ka gano shi.
z-m-08-06.s.s3.hint.1: Rubuta abin da ke faruwa idan rufewar ta gaza wannan bambanci da kuma idan ta fi shi.
z-m-08-06.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: Idan rufewar ta kasance ... ko ƙasa da haka, to ...
z-m-08-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Shin ka kuma rubuta abin da ke faruwa idan rufewar ta fi 5 cm?
z-m-08-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Shin ka bayyana yadda ka gano bambancin 4.05 m da 4 m ya zama 0.05 m (5 cm)?
z-m-08-06.s.s3.model.0: Idan ka rufe ribbon ɗin ka haɗa, dole ne ka cire tsawon rufewar daga jimillar 4.05 m. 4.05 m ya fi 4 m da 0.05 m (5 cm), saboda haka idan rufewar ta kai 5 cm ko ƙasa, 4 m zai rage ya isa; idan rufewar ta fi 5 cm, ba zai isa ba.
z-m-08-06.s.s3.model.1: Idan babu rufewa, tsawonsa 4.05 m ne, saboda haka ya isa; amma idan akwai rufewa sakamakon ya bambanta. 4.05 m − 4 m = 0.05 m, saboda haka idan rufewar ta fi 5 cm, zai gaza.

z-m-08-01.title: Teburin lissafin Minjae na adadin shafukan littattafai 23.
z-m-08-01.topic: Ƙimar matsayi yayin ninka lamba mai lambobi uku da mai lambobi biyu.
z-m-08-01.goal: Nemo layin da ƙimar matsayi ta yi kuskure a teburin ninkawa a jere, ka duba amsa ta hanyar ƙiyasta da amfani da lambar ƙarshe, sannan ka sake rubuta ta daidai.
z-m-08-01.material: A ɗakin karatu an sayi littattafan labari 23, kowanne yana da shafuka 346. Minjae ya yi ninkawa a jere don nemo jimillar shafuka. Babu hoto, saboda haka an rubuta teburin lissafinsa da kalmomi, layi-layi.
z-m-08-01.thinking.1: Duba sakamakon ta hanyar ƙiyasta da amfani da lambar ƙarshe.
z-m-08-01.thinking.2: Bayyana lissafin da aka gyara da dalilinsa.
z-m-08-01.prereq.0: Karanta teburin ninkawa a jere da gano ƙimar matsayin ɗaya, goma, ɗari (matakin aji na 4).
z-m-08-01.prereq.1: Kwatanta girman sakamakon lissafi da ƙimar da aka ƙiyasta.
z-m-08-01.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layin farko a teburin lissafin Minjae da ya fara kuskure.
z-m-08-01.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane layi, rubuta da kalmomi ƙimar da mai ninkawa ke da ita (wane matsayi ne lambar 2 take ciki).
z-m-08-01.s.s1.hint.1: Kiyasta kusan shafuka nawa littattafai 20 masu shafuka 346 za su yi, sannan ka kwatanta da 1730.
z-m-08-01.s.s1.line.0: Rubuta 23 ƙarƙashin 346, ka fara ninkawa da 3 a matsayin ɗaya.
z-m-08-01.s.s1.line.1: Rubuta 346 × 3 = 1038, a jera matsayinsu na ɗaya.
z-m-08-01.s.s1.line.2: Ninka da 2 a matsayin goma-goma ma. Rubuta 346 × 2 = 692, ƙarshen dama ya yi daidai da na 1038.
z-m-08-01.s.s1.line.3: Idan aka tara 1038 da 692 a tsaye, 1730 ne.
z-m-08-01.s.s1.line.4: Saboda haka littattafan 23 suna da shafuka 1730 gaba ɗaya.
z-m-08-01.s.s1.explain: Kuskuren farko ya faru a layi na 3. 2 a cikin 23 yana a matsayin goma-goma, saboda haka yana nufin 20, ba 2 ba. Don haka 346 × 2 = 692 ya kamata a rubuta matsayi ɗaya zuwa hagu (a karanta 692 a matsayin 6920). Haɗawar layi na 4, 1038 + 692 = 1730, daidai ce ita kaɗai, amma lambobin da aka haɗa ba daidai ba ne, amsar layi na 5 kuma ta fito daga hakan.
z-m-08-01.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi duk dalilan da za su nuna cewa shafuka 1730 ba daidai ba ne ba tare da kammala lissafin ba.
z-m-08-01.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko kiyasci kusan sau nawa shafukan littattafai 23 za su kai na littafi ɗaya.
z-m-08-01.s.s2.hint.1: Ba tare da lissafi ba, yanke shawarar ko kowane zaɓi gaskiya ne ko ƙarya, sannan ka duba ko zaɓuɓɓukan gaskiya sun saɓa da 1730.
z-m-08-01.s.s2.o.a: 346 ya fi 300, 23 kuma ya fi 20, saboda haka samfurin dole ya fi 6000.
z-m-08-01.s.s2.r.a: Ƙiyasta girman farko al'ada ce mai kyau.
z-m-08-01.s.s2.o.b: 346 da 23 duka lambobi ne masu-cika-biyu, saboda haka samfurin dole ya zama mai-cika-biyu, amma 1730 marar-cika-biyu ce.
z-m-08-01.s.s2.r.b: 23 marar-cika-biyu ce, 1730 kuma mai-cika-biyu ce. Idan ana magana game da masu-cika-biyu da marasa-cika-biyu, da farko a duba lambobin biyu da ake ninkawa daidai.
z-m-08-01.s.s2.o.c: Tunda 6 × 3 = 18, lambar ɗaya ta samfurin dole ta zama 8, amma 1730 tana ƙarewa da 0.
z-m-08-01.s.s2.r.c: Ninka lambobin ɗaya don duba lambar ƙarshe hanya ce mai kyau ta dubawa ma.
z-m-08-01.s.s2.o.d: Tunda 692 ya yi ƙasa da 1038, jimillar 1730 dole ta yi ƙasa da 1038.
z-m-08-01.s.s2.r.d: Ƙara lambobi biyu yana samar da sakamakon da ya fi kowanne daga cikinsu. Sake duba yadda ake kwatanta jimilla da ɗaya daga lambobin biyu.
z-m-08-01.s.s2.o.e: Kowane littafi yana da shafuka 346, littattafai 23 ne, don haka amsar dole ta fi 346, kuma 1730 ya fi 346.
z-m-08-01.s.s2.r.e: Gaskiya ne 1730 ya fi 346. Amma wannan kaɗai bai nuna cewa 1730 ba daidai ba ne. Dole ne ka ƙiyasta girman da ya fi dacewa.
z-m-08-01.s.s2.explain: Idan aka ƙiyasta 300 × 20 = 6000, amsar dole ta fi shafuka 6000, kuma daga ninkar lambobin raka’a 6 × 3 = 18, lambar ƙarshe dole ta zama 8. Babu dalili da ya dace da 1730. Dalilin mara ko kuma (b) bai daidai ba domin 23 mara ce, d da e kuma ba shaida ba ne cewa 1730 ba daidai ba ne.
z-m-08-01.s.s3.prompt: Sake rubuta teburin lissafin Minjae ka nemo daidai adadin shafuka. Haka kuma ka bayyana da kalmominka dalilin da ya sa layin da ka canja dole a gyara shi haka.
z-m-08-01.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko rubuta darajar da lamba 2 a gurbin goma ke wakilta.
z-m-08-01.s.s3.hint.1: Jera sakamakon 346 × 2 da 346 × 20 kusa da juna ka kwatanta wanda ya dace da layin da aka gyara.
z-m-08-01.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: Lamba 2 a gurbin goma tana nufin ...
z-m-08-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Shin ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa lambar da aka ninka da 346 a lissafin gyara ita ce 20 (ko daraja kamar 6920) maimakon 2?
z-m-08-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Shin ka tabbatar ta hanyar ƙiyastawa ko duba lambar ƙarshe cewa hanyar da ka yi amfani da ita (ƙara 0, matsar da wuri ɗaya hagu, ninka da 20) ta yi daidai da shafuka 7958?
z-m-08-01.s.s3.model.0: 346 × 20 = 6920. Lamba 2 a gurbin goma tana nufin 20, saboda haka dole a rubuta 6920, ba 692 ba. 1038 + 6920 = shafuka 7958.
z-m-08-01.s.s3.model.1: Matsar da 692 wuri ɗaya zuwa hagu. Idan aka ninka da lamba a gurbin goma, gurbin raka’a babu komai, dole a ɗauka yana da 0. 1038 + 6920 = 7958, don haka shafuka 7958 ne.

z-m-08-03.title: Sanya 14 a kowace akwati don ragowar su zama mara ko kuma
z-m-08-03.topic: Alaƙar rabo da ragowa a rabawa
z-m-08-03.goal: Koyon zangon darajojin ragowar, ƙirƙirar misalai daban-daban na mai rabawa, rabo, da ragowa da suka cika sharudda, sannan bayyana dalilin zangon.
z-m-08-03.material: Masana’antar cakulan tana sa cakulan 14 daidai a kowace akwati. Akwatuna cike kaɗai ake ƙirga, ragowar cakulan da ba su cika akwati ba ana aje su gefe. A ce adadin cakulan da aka yi shi ne a, adadin akwatuna cikakku q, ragowar cakulan r. (a yana tsakanin 100 da 999.)
z-m-08-03.thinking.0: Bambance yanayin da zai iya faruwa da wanda ba zai yiwu ba
z-m-08-03.thinking.1: Samar da misalai da suka cika sharudda da dama lokaci guda
z-m-08-03.prereq.0: Rabo da ragowa a rabawa (aji na 3–4)
z-m-08-03.prereq.1: Sanin alaƙar mai rabawa × rabo + ragowa = mai rabawa
z-m-08-03.s.s1.prompt: Ana zuba cakulan 14 a kowane akwati, akwai aƙalla gunduwa 1 da ta rage. Zaɓi duk lambobin da ragowar cakulan r za ta iya zama.
z-m-08-03.s.s1.hint.0: Yi tunanin abin da za ka iya yi da ragowar idan guda 14 ne.
z-m-08-03.s.s1.hint.1: Ga kowane zaɓi, duba ɗaya bayan ɗaya ko ragowar cakulan za ta iya cika wani akwati.
z-m-08-03.s.s1.r.a: Idan guda 14 suka rage, za ka iya saka waɗannan guda 14 a akwati guda. Me zai faru da adadin akwatuna?
z-m-08-03.s.s1.r.b: Ka yi tunanin yanayin da ragowar ba ta kai 14 ba.
z-m-08-03.s.s1.r.c: Idan guda 17 suka rage, za ka iya cika wani akwati. Nawa ne zai rage? Sake tunanin mafi yawan adadin ragowar.
z-m-08-03.s.s1.r.d: Wannan yanayin ne inda guda ɗaya kaɗai ya rage kafin akwati ta cika.
z-m-08-03.s.s1.r.e: Idan guda 28 suka rage, za ka iya cika ƙarin akwatuna biyu. Sake tunanin zangon ragowar.
z-m-08-03.s.s1.r.f: Ka gano yanayin da ragowar ba ta kai 14 ba.
z-m-08-03.s.s1.explain: Akwatuna cikakku kaɗai ake ƙirga, don haka idan guda 14 ko fiye suka rage za a iya cika ƙarin akwatuna. Saboda haka ragowar daga 1 zuwa 13 ce kawai. 5, 13, da 9 masu yiwuwa ne; 14, 17, da 28 kuma ba za su yiwu ba.
z-m-08-03.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri yanayi 3 daban-daban da adadin cakulan a, akwatuna cikakku q, da ragowar r suka cika sharuddan. Sharudda: akwatuna sun kai aƙalla 10 amma ba fiye da 99 ba, ragowar kuma mara ce.
z-m-08-03.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko zaɓi adadin akwatuna q, sannan ka gano yawan cakulan a cikin akwatuna q masu cakulan 14.
z-m-08-03.s.s2.hint.1: Ƙara ragowar mara zuwa wannan don samun a, sannan ka tabbatar ragowar ta yi ƙasa da 14.
z-m-08-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Dukkan lambobi uku lambobi ne na halitta.
z-m-08-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Ƙididdigar dole ta zama lambobi na halitta.
z-m-08-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Adadin cakulan da aka yi dole ya kasance tsakanin 100 da 999.
z-m-08-03.s.s2.ok.c3: Akwatuna sun kai aƙalla 10 amma ba fiye da 99 ba.
z-m-08-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Akwatuna cikakku dole su kai aƙalla 10 amma ba fiye da 99 ba.
z-m-08-03.s.s2.ok.c4: Cakulan da ke cikin akwatuna da ragowar idan an haɗa su sun yi daidai da adadin cakulan da aka yi.
z-m-08-03.s.s2.fail.c4: Haɗa cakulan da ke cikin akwatuna 14 da ragowar, ka duba ko jimillar ta yi daidai da a.
z-m-08-03.s.s2.ok.c5: Ragowar cakulan ba ta kai 14 ba.
z-m-08-03.s.s2.fail.c5: Idan ragowar cakulan ta kai 14 ko fiye, za a iya cika wasu akwatuna. Ragowar dole ta yi ƙasa da 14.
z-m-08-03.s.s2.fail.c6: Ragowar cakulan ba mara ba ce.
z-m-08-03.s.s2.explain: Misali, 14 × 12 + 5 = 173, saboda haka cakulan 173 suna cika akwatuna 12, guda 5 kuma su rage. 14 × 25 + 9 = 359, 14 × 40 + 13 = 573, da 14 × 71 + 1 = 995 ma sun cika sharuddan. Idan ka rubuta cakulan 188 a matsayin akwatuna 12 da ragowa 20, jimillar daidai ce, amma ba daidai ba ne domin ragowar 20 za ta iya cika wani akwati.
z-m-08-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Me ya sa ragowar r dole ta yi ƙasa da 14? Rubuta dalili da kalmominka.
z-m-08-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Rubuta ɗaya bayan ɗaya abin da za ka iya yi da ragowar idan r=14, 15, da 20.
z-m-08-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Rubuta yadda q da r suke canzawa bayan ka yi haka.
z-m-08-03.s.s2.because.placeholder: Misali: Idan guda 14 ko fiye suka rage, ...
z-m-08-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Shin dalilinka ya haɗu da abin da ke faruwa idan ragowar ta kai 14 ko fiye (cika ƙarin akwati)?
z-m-08-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Shin ka tabbatar r ta yi ƙasa da 14 a duk misalan ukun?
z-m-08-03.s.s2.because.model.0: Idan ragowar cakulan ta kai 14 ko fiye, za ka iya cika wani akwati. Sai adadin akwatuna ya ƙaru da 1, ragowar kuma ta ragu. Saboda haka ragowar dole ta yi ƙasa da 14.
z-m-08-03.s.s2.because.model.1: Ragowar ita ce abin da ya rage bayan cire rukunin 14. Idan sama da 14 suka rage, za ka iya cire wani rukuni. Adadin da ya rage lokacin da ba za a iya cire wani ba shi ne ragowa, don haka ya yi ƙasa da 14.

z-m-08-05.title: Tsawon da ya rage bayan amfani da 3.47 m daga ribbon mai tsawon 10 m
z-m-08-05.topic: Kwatanta hanyoyin cire adadin decimal mai wurare biyu daga cikakkiyar lamba
z-m-08-05.goal: Kwatanta hanyoyi da dama na warware matsala ɗaya domin zaɓar waɗanda suka dace, yi amfani da kimantawa wajen kawar da amsoshin da ba daidai ba, sannan ka faɗi hanyar da ta dace da waɗannan lambobin da dalili.
z-m-08-05.material:
An yanke aka yi amfani da 3.47 m daga ribbon mai tsawon 10 m. Abokai biyar sun gano tsawon ribbon da ya rage kamar haka.
Mina: Cire 3 daga 10 ya zama 7, sannan a haɗa ɓangaren decimal 0.47 yadda yake, saboda haka 7.47 m.
Jiho: Rubuta 10 a matsayin 10.00, daidaita wuraren decimal, sannan a cire a jere, a samu 6.53 m.
Haneel: Canja 3.47 zuwa 3.5 a cire, a samu daidai 6.5 m.
Raon: Dauki 10 a matsayin 1000/100, 3.47 kuma 347/100, a samu 653/100, wato 6.53 m.
Soyeon: Cire 3 daga 10 ya zama 7, sannan a cire ƙarin 0.47 daga 7, a samu 6.53 m.
z-m-08-05.thinking.0: Yanke shawarar waɗanne hanyoyin warwarewa ne daidai
z-m-08-05.thinking.1: Duba ko amsa tana da ma'ana ta hanyar kimantawa
z-m-08-05.thinking.2: Kwatanta hanyoyi, zaɓi ɗaya, sannan ka faɗi lokacin da ta dace
z-m-08-05.prereq.0: Ma'anar adadin decimal mai wurare biyu da daidaita alamomin decimal
z-m-08-05.prereq.1: Dangantakar kasrori masu rabawa 100 da adadin decimal (matakin aji na 4)
z-m-08-05.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk hanyoyin da ke gano ainihin tsawon ribbon da ya rage daidai.
z-m-08-05.s.s1.hint.0: Bi hanyar kowane aboki, sannan ka rubuta abin da ya faru da 3.47 yayin cire shi daga 10.
z-m-08-05.s.s1.hint.1: Duba ko wata hanya da ta ce tana samun ainihin ƙima ta canja ko ta bar wata lamba.
z-m-08-05.s.s1.r.a: Idan ka haɗa ɓangaren decimal yadda yake, 3 kaɗai ka cire daga 3.47. Ka sake duba abin da aka yi da 0.47.
z-m-08-05.s.s1.r.b: Wannan hanya ce ta daidaita alamomin decimal sannan a cire lambobin da ke matsayi iri ɗaya.
z-m-08-05.s.s1.r.c: Canja 3.47 zuwa 3.5 yana canja ƙimarsa. Kimantawa ba hanya ba ce ta gano ainihin ƙima.
z-m-08-05.s.s1.r.d: Wannan hanya ce da ke amfani da rabawa iri ɗaya sannan ta cire masu lamba a sama.
z-m-08-05.s.s1.r.e: Wannan hanya ce da ke raba cirewar zuwa matakai biyu.
z-m-08-05.s.s1.explain: Hanyoyin Jiho, Raon, da Soyeon duk suna samun daidai 6.53 m. Mina ba ta cire 0.47 ba, ta haɗa shi ne kawai, ta samu 7.47; Haneel kuma ta canja 3.47 zuwa 3.5, ta samu 6.5, wanda ba ainihin ƙima ba ne. Ana iya amfani da hanyar Haneel wajen kimantawa.
z-m-08-05.s.s2.prompt: Wane ne mafi kyawun dalilin da za ka bayar, ba tare da gama lissafi ba, da ke nuna amsar Mina 7.47 m ba daidai ba ce?
z-m-08-05.s.s2.hint.0: Kwatanta wanne ya fi ƙanƙanta: 10 a cire 3, ko 10 a cire 3.47.
z-m-08-05.s.s2.hint.1: Ga kowane zaɓi, faɗi ko maganar shaida ce cewa 7.47 ba daidai ba ne ko kawai ta faɗi gaskiya.
z-m-08-05.s.s2.o.a: Sashen decimal na amsar yana da lambobi biyu, don haka sakamakon ya ba da mamaki
z-m-08-05.s.s2.r.a: Adadin decimal mai wurare biyu na iya zama amsa. Yawan wuraren decimal ba dalilin yanke hukunci cewa akwai kuskure ba.
z-m-08-05.s.s2.o.b: Amsa 7.47 ta fi lambar da ake cirewa, 3.47, saboda haka abin mamaki ne
z-m-08-05.s.s2.r.b: Gaskiya ne 7.47 ya fi 3.47, amma wannan ba dalilin kuskurensa ba ne.
z-m-08-05.s.s2.o.c: Kana cire lambar da ta fi 3 daga 10, amma amsar ta fi 7
z-m-08-05.s.s2.r.c: Wannan kimantawa ce: tunda 3.47 ya fi 3, tsawon da ya rage dole ya kasa 7.
z-m-08-05.s.s2.o.d: Amsar da ke da alamar decimal ba za ta iya zama sakamakon irin wannan cirewa ba
z-m-08-05.s.s2.r.d: A cirewa da lambobin decimal, amsar da ke da alamar decimal abu ne na al'ada.
z-m-08-05.s.s2.explain: Ka cire 3.47, wanda ya fi 3, daga 10, don haka tsawon da ya rage dole ya gaza 7. 7.47 na Mina ya fi 7, saboda haka za ka iya ganin abin mamaki ne ba tare da gama lissafi ba.
z-m-08-05.s.s3.prompt: Daga cikin hanyoyi uku da ke samun amsa daidai (Jiho, Raon, Soyeon), zaɓi wadda ta fi dacewa da wannan lissafi a ganinka, ka rubuta dalili. Ƙara layi ɗaya kan yadda lambobin za su canza domin wata hanya ta fi dacewa.
z-m-08-05.s.s3.hint.0: Gwada hanyoyin ukun da kanka, sannan ka yi alama ga wadda kuskure ya fi sauƙin shiga.
z-m-08-05.s.s3.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin yadda kowace hanya za ta canza idan lambar da ake cirewa ta zama 3.472 ko 3.4.
z-m-08-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Shin ka tabbatar hanyar da ka zaɓa tana ba da daidai 6.53 m?
z-m-08-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Shin ka yi tunanin ko hanyar da ka zaɓa za ta ci gaba da amfani idan lambobin sun canza (misali 3.472 ko 100 maimakon 10)?
z-m-08-05.s.s3.model.0: Ina ganin cirewa a ginshiƙi ta Jiho mai sauƙi ce. Idan ka rubuta 10 a matsayin 10.00, alamomin decimal suna daidaita, don haka kuskure ya ragu. Amma idan lambar gajera ce kamar 3.4, raba ta matakai biyu kamar ta Soyeon na iya sauri.
z-m-08-05.s.s3.model.1: Hanyar Soyeon mai sauƙi ce. Ka cire 3 daga 10 ya zama 7, sannan ka cire 0.47, saboda haka za ka iya yi a rai. Idan lambobin sun rikitar, cirewa a ginshiƙi ta fi aminci.

z-m-08-08.title: Girman ɓangaren da aka yi wa launi a grid mai murabba'ai 100
z-m-08-08.topic: Adadin decimal mai wurare biyu da ake gani a grid mai murabba'ai 100
z-m-08-08.goal: Ɗauki grid mai murabba'ai 100 a matsayin 1, rubuta adadin murabba'ai a matsayin decimal mai wurare biyu, sannan ka ƙirƙiri girma da dama da suka dace tsakanin decimal biyun da kanka.
z-m-08-08.material: Akwai takardar grid mai murabba'ai 10 a faɗi da 10 a tsawo, jimilla murabba'ai 100. Ka ce girman takardar grid gaba ɗaya 1 ne. Sai murabba'i ɗaya ya zama 0.01. Za ka yi wa murabba'ai ja da shuɗi launi, kana amfani da launi guda ɗaya a kowane murabba'i kuma ba ka maimaita yi wa murabba'i ɗaya launi.
z-m-08-08.thinking.0: Fahimtar yadda grid da adadin decimal suka dace
z-m-08-08.thinking.1: Ƙirƙirar girma da suka cika sharudda da dama lokaci guda
z-m-08-08.thinking.2: Bayyana kewayon girma ta amfani da adadin decimal
z-m-08-08.prereq.0: Kasrori masu rabawa 100 da adadin decimal mai wurare biyu
z-m-08-08.prereq.1: Kwatanta girman adadin decimal (matakin aji na 4)
z-m-08-08.s.s1.prompt: An yi wa murabba'ai 25 ja. Wace kwatancin girman wannan ɓangare ce daidai?
z-m-08-08.s.s1.hint.0: Idan aka yi la'akari da cewa duk grid ɗin yana da murabba'ai 100, jeri ɗaya kuma yana da murabba'ai 10, da farko rubuta irin ɓangaren dukkan grid da jeri ɗaya yake.
z-m-08-08.s.s1.hint.1: Nemo murabba'ai nawa ne 0.3 idan aka rubuta shi 0.30, sannan ka kwatanta da murabba'ai 25.
z-m-08-08.s.s1.o.a: Murabba'ai 25 su ne 0.025, domin murabba'i ɗaya 0.001 ne.
z-m-08-08.s.s1.r.a: Duk grid ɗin yana da murabba'ai 100, saboda haka murabba'i ɗaya 1/100 ne. 0.001 murabba'i ɗaya ne idan aka raba duka zuwa murabba'ai 1000.
z-m-08-08.s.s1.o.b: Murabba'ai 25 su ne 0.25, kuma ya fi 0.3 girma domin 25 ya fi 3.
z-m-08-08.s.s1.r.b: Ana iya rubuta 0.3 a matsayin 0.30. Kada ka kwatanta 25 da 3 yadda suke; kwatanta matsayi ɗaya.
z-m-08-08.s.s1.o.c: Murabba'ai 25 su ne 0.25, kuma ya gaza 0.3. 0.3 murabba'ai 30 ne.
z-m-08-08.s.s1.r.c: Ka sauya lamba mai wuri ɗaya bayan maki goma 0.3 zuwa mai wuri biyu, ka danganta ta da adadin murabba'ai.
z-m-08-08.s.s1.o.d: Murabba'ai 25 su ne 2.5, domin murabba'ai 10 su ne 1.
z-m-08-08.s.s1.r.d: Jeri ɗaya (murabba'ai 10) ba 1 na dukkan grid ba ne, 0.1 ne. Dukan grid yana da murabba'ai 100.
z-m-08-08.s.s1.explain: Dukan grid yana da murabba'ai 100, don haka murabba'i ɗaya 0.01 ne, murabba'ai 25 kuma 0.25 ne. 0.3 daidai yake da 0.30, wato murabba'ai 30, saboda haka murabba'ai 25 sun gaza 0.3.
z-m-08-08.s.s2.prompt: Yi wa murabba'ai r ja, b kuma shuɗi. Sharudda: ka yi ja ya fi 0.2 amma ya gaza 0.3, shuɗi ya fi 0.05 amma ya gaza 0.1. Jimillar murabba'ai masu launi (r+b) dole ta zama marar-cika-biyu, kuma jimillar ta fi 0.3 amma ta gaza 0.4. Yi adadin murabba'ai mabambanta guda 3 da suka cika sharudda. (Idan jimillar murabba'ai masu launi ta bambanta, ana ƙirga a matsayin yanayi dabam.)
z-m-08-08.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko rubuta zangon yawan murabba'ai da za ka iya yi wa ja da waɗanda za ka iya yi wa shuɗi, kowanne a matsayin adadin murabba'ai.
z-m-08-08.s.s2.hint.1: Zaɓi adadin ja guda da na shuɗi guda, ka haɗa su, ka tabbatar jimillar lamba marar-cika-biyu ce tsakanin murabba'ai 31 da 39.
z-m-08-08.s.s2.ok.c2: Yankin ja ya fi 0.2 girma amma ya gaza 0.3.
z-m-08-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Ja dole ya kasance tsakanin murabba'ai 21 da 29. 0.2 murabba'ai 20 ne, 0.3 kuma 30 ne.
z-m-08-08.s.s2.ok.c3: Yankin shuɗi ya fi 0.05 girma amma ya gaza 0.1.
z-m-08-08.s.s2.fail.c3: Shuɗi dole ya kasance tsakanin murabba'ai 6 da 9. 0.05 murabba'ai 5 ne, 0.1 kuma 10 ne.
z-m-08-08.s.s2.ok.c4: Dukkan yankin mai launi ya fi 0.3 girma amma ya gaza 0.4.
z-m-08-08.s.s2.fail.c4: Jimillar murabba'ai ja da shuɗi ba ta tsakanin murabba'ai 31 da 39 ba.
z-m-08-08.s.s2.ok.c5: Jimillar murabba'ai masu launi lamba marar-cika-biyu ce.
z-m-08-08.s.s2.fail.c5: Jimillar murabba'ai ba lamba marar-cika-biyu ba ce.
z-m-08-08.s.s2.explain: (25, 8) murabba'ai 33 ne, wato 0.33; (22, 9) murabba'ai 31 ne, wato 0.31; (28, 9) murabba'ai 37 ne, wato 0.37; (29, 6) kuma murabba'ai 35 ne, wato 0.35. Jimillar da za ta yiwu guda huɗu ne: murabba'ai 31, 33, 35, 37, dukkansu lambobi marasa-cika-biyu ne tsakanin 0.30 da 0.40 (ba za a iya yin murabba'ai 39 ba, domin ko ja 29 da shuɗi 9 idan aka haɗa 38 ne kawai). Idan r da b mabambanta sun ba da jimilla ɗaya, a ƙirga yanayi ɗaya.
z-m-08-08.s.s2.because.prompt: Zaɓi ɗaya daga cikin yanayin da ka yi, ka rubuta jimillar murabba'ai masu launi a matsayin decimal, ka faɗi dalilin da ya sa ta fi 0.3 kuma ta gaza 0.4.
z-m-08-08.s.s2.because.hint.0: Rubuta jimillar murabba'ai da ka samu ta haɗa r da b a yanayin da ka zaɓa, sannan ka rubuta decimal ɗin da za ka samu idan ka raba adadin da 100.
z-m-08-08.s.s2.because.hint.1: Mayar da 0.3 da 0.4 kowannensu zuwa adadin murabba'ai ka kwatanta su gefe da gefe.
z-m-08-08.s.s2.because.placeholder: Misali: Ja ... murabba'ai + shuɗi ... murabba'ai = ... murabba'ai, saboda haka ...
z-m-08-08.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Jimillar murabba'ai a yanayin da ka zaɓa da gaske lamba marar-cika-biyu ce tsakanin murabba'ai 31 da 39?
z-m-08-08.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ka mayar da 0.3 da 0.4 zuwa adadin murabba'ai a grid (murabba'ai 30 da 40), ka kwatanta su?
z-m-08-08.s.s2.because.model.0: Ja murabba'ai 25 da shuɗi 8 sun zama murabba'ai 33, wato 0.33. 0.3 daidai yake da 0.30, murabba'ai 30 ne, 0.4 kuma murabba'ai 40 ne, murabba'ai 33 na tsakaninsu.
z-m-08-08.s.s2.because.model.1: 28+9=37 murabba'ai, wato 0.37. 0.37 ya fi 0.30 amma ya gaza 0.40, domin ya fi murabba'ai 30 amma ya gaza 40.
